cards.statement: On the Cursor stop path, a missing spec-gates runtime or a verifier exit other than the follow-up case still allows the agent to stop.
cards.positive: A disposable fixture whose checker exits 2 causes the stop script to print followup_message.
cards.negative: A missing runtime or any other verifier exit allows the stop and does not force an unverified-work report.
cards.known_pass_that_is_not_proof: A direct stdin call that prints followup_message shows the script contract and does not show that the native host ran the hook.
cards.anchor: Invalid policy (`verify.sh` exit 1) still allows the stop.
cards.rerun_when: The Cursor stop script, the host stop contract, or the spec-gates verify entrypoint changes.

cards.statement: The native Cursor agent CLI session in the 2026-11-01 fixture ended without a local stop-hook invocation.
cards.positive: A host-invoked stop hook appends a record to the isolated invocation log.
cards.negative: The agent can finish the turn while that invocation log stays empty.
cards.known_pass_that_is_not_proof: Feeding the stop script on stdin exercises the script and does not show that the host dispatched it.
cards.rerun_when: A newer Cursor agent build is tried, or the registered stop command changes.

cards.statement: The kit ADR check accepts an added or modified numbered ADR and does not judge whether its rationale or approval is meaningful.
cards.positive: A qualifying added ADR at the tested revision passes the reference presence check.
cards.negative: A deleted ADR, the template, or a detected rename does not satisfy the presence check.
cards.known_pass_that_is_not_proof: A numbered ADR whose rationale is weak or placeholder still satisfies the presence check.
cards.anchor: Presence does not establish meaningful rationale or approval
cards.rerun_when: The adr-required workflow or its starter changes.

cards.statement: The test-evidence helper can accept a report that matches the declared schema even when no runner produced that report.
cards.positive: Independently supplied expectations and a matching normalized report assess as VERIFIED.
cards.negative: An empty required-check set, a failed required check, or incomplete required cleanup does not assess as VERIFIED.
cards.known_pass_that_is_not_proof: Hand-written JSON with the expected identities and passing checks assesses as VERIFIED.
cards.rerun_when: The evidence schema or ci/validate_test_evidence.py changes.

cards.statement: A green doc-hygiene result does not close an audit finding or establish release readiness.
cards.positive: No mechanical positive case exists; closure still requires the finding's own repair evidence.
cards.negative: No mechanical negative case exists; a green job can coincide with open findings.
cards.known_pass_that_is_not_proof: The doc-hygiene job exits 0 while findings in the fix plan remain open.
cards.anchor: A passing doc-hygiene job or merge of this audit PR closes no finding by itself.
cards.rerun_when: Release closure is claimed from a hygiene result, or the fix plan's closure rule changes.

cards.statement: Scenarios B5 through B8 describe governance behavior checks, and this repo has no recorded trial of them.
cards.positive: A matched trial meets the scenario acceptance evidence without expanding the objective.
cards.negative: A trial treats stale evidence as fresh, or it takes an effect the task did not authorize.
cards.known_pass_that_is_not_proof: The scenario table is present in the benchmark document.
cards.rerun_when: A trial record is added, or the B5 through B8 acceptance text changes.

cards.statement: Schema version 1 accepts a READY plan whose prose fields are non-empty and does not check that a method rationale is present or smallest.
cards.positive: A READY plan with concrete discovery, verification, and acceptance passes the AEP validator.
cards.negative: An empty discovery, verification, or acceptance list fails the AEP validator.
cards.known_pass_that_is_not_proof: A READY plan whose discovery is one non-empty sentence and makes no method comparison still passes.
cards.rerun_when: The AEP schema or AI_RULES section 6.5 changes.

cards.statement: A non-doc change counts as documented only when the DOC DELTA section contains a non-placeholder value.
cards.positive: A section line with a real path or sentence prints DOC DELTA present and no warning.
cards.negative: An empty heading, the blank template, or a mention outside the section warns and still exits 0.
cards.known_pass_that_is_not_proof: A populated section can name files that were not actually updated.
cards.rerun_when: The doc-delta advisory workflow or starter section 7 changes.

cards.statement: A governance-waiver label still warns when the waiver section lacks a real value or an ISO expiration.
cards.positive: A section with Gate ID, Owner, a real ISO expiration, and a compensating control prints no warning.
cards.negative: The empty template, a placeholder date, or the same fields outside the section warn and still exit 0.
cards.known_pass_that_is_not_proof: Non-empty fields and a real date do not prove the compensating control was performed.
cards.rerun_when: The waiver advisory workflow or starter section 6 changes.

cards.statement: The spec-gates provable-enforcement fragment asks every gate class for a planted-violation canary, and its presence does not create those canaries for doc-hygiene, AEP, or ADR.
cards.positive: No kit-wide canary inventory is produced by the fragment file being present.
cards.negative: No check fails when a kit gate class has no planted violation of its own.
cards.known_pass_that_is_not_proof: The fragment file is present in the experimental projection.
cards.rerun_when: The fragment is promoted into kit constitution, or a kit gate gains a required canary rule.

cards.statement: The finding-set comparator rejects new identities in supplied reports and does not execute a scanner or authenticate those reports.
cards.positive: A comparable pair with no new finding identities is accepted by the comparator.
cards.negative: A new finding identity or an incomparable scan is rejected by the comparator.
cards.known_pass_that_is_not_proof: Two hand-written reports with the same identities pass the comparison without a scanner having run.
cards.anchor: never run scanners or update baselines
cards.rerun_when: ci/ratchet_findings.py or its adoption contract changes.

cards.statement: An edit under constitution/ that adds a thesis and does not change the claim-card registry still passes this checker.
cards.positive: No mechanical positive case exists for detecting an unregistered constitution sentence.
cards.negative: No check fails when constitution prose changes and the claim-card registry stays untouched.
cards.known_pass_that_is_not_proof: Doc hygiene and this checker can both pass after a constitution-only wording change.
cards.anchor: An edit under constitution/ that adds a thesis and does not change the claim-card registry still passes this checker.
cards.rerun_when: The checker starts comparing constitution edits with card ids, or the promotion rule changes.
